title: Oscillating dipole and radiation (3D, 3D+t)
description: The complete near- and far-zone fields of an oscillating (Hertzian) dipole. 3-D: the time-averaged Poynting flux integrated over spheres from kr = 0.3 (reactive near zone) to kr = 30 is the same radiated power, eta k^2 |I l|^2 / (12 pi); the directivity is 1.5. 3D+t: the real fields in space and time, the energy through a sphere over one period, and Faraday and Ampere-Maxwell residuals of the 4-D field (pp.maxwell).
